patch_description: The original greedily assigns models in descending r/s order to the GPU with the currently lowest KVPR. I keep the feasibility handling but improve it with two ideas: (1) assign each model to the GPU that minimizes the *resulting* KVPR after placement (a best-fit look-ahead), and (2) add a local-search refinement pass that repeatedly moves a model from the max-KVPR GPU to another GPU whenever it reduces the global maximum KVPR. This hill-climbing fix-up escapes the greedy's early bad commitments while staying simple and fast.
